_comment: No real secrets belong in this tracked file. Supply your own local values with 'dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:CrmDb "..."' (run from the Neurix/ folder) or environment variables (ConnectionStrings__CrmDb, Gemini__ApiKey, Crm__SeedAdmin__Password) before running the app. Without a CrmDb value the public site still runs; CRM/CMS sign-in and dashboard features stay unavailable until one is supplied.
